src/integrations/sync/garmin.rs.description: Garmin Connect API uses SYNCHRONOUS upload processing - returns activity ID immediately in the response (unlike Strava which uses async and requires polling). The upload_activity() method returns SyncRecordStatus::Completed directly. No check_upload_status() method is needed for Garmin.

src/integrations/sync/strava.rs.description: Fully implemented Strava client with multipart FIT upload, OAuth token management, athlete profile retrieval, deauthorization, and comprehensive error handling. Use as pattern for Garmin implementation.

src/ui/screens/settings_strava.rs.description: StravaSettingsScreen provides the UI pattern for connection settings: connection states (Disconnected, Connecting, Connected, Disconnecting, Error), athlete profile display, auto-sync toggle, and action handling. Copy this pattern for GarminSettingsScreen.

src/integrations/sync/oauth.rs.description: Garmin OAuth token exchange is fully implemented: exchange_garmin_token (lines 603-673) handles authorization code exchange, refresh_garmin_token (lines 898+) handles token refresh, handle_callback routes GarminConnect correctly. Uses GarminTokenResponse with expires_in (not expires_at like Strava) and GarminOAuthErrorResponse for errors. Comprehensive test coverage in the garmin_oauth_tests module.

src/integrations/sync/service.rs.description: Upload queue retry logic uses SyncErrorExt trait from garmin.rs for sophisticated error categorization. is_retryable_error() delegates to SyncErrorExt::is_retryable() which considers error category (Transient, RateLimited, Server, Client, Authentication, Permanent) and message content. Rate-limited errors use get_rate_limit_retry_delay() for API-suggested delays instead of exponential backoff. Garmin uploads are processed via process_single_upload() which handles TokenExpired (re-auth required), DuplicateActivity (marked completed), InvalidFitFile (permanent failure), and retryable errors (scheduled for retry with backoff).

src/integrations/sync/mod.rs.description: SyncPlatform enum defines all supported sync platforms (GarminConnect, Strava, TrainingPeaks, IntervalsIcu, HealthKit). Each platform has display_name(), auth_url_base(), and uses_oauth() methods. SyncConfig::default() initializes all platforms with default PlatformConfig (enabled=false, auto_sync=false).

src/ui/screens/settings_garmin.rs.description: GarminSettingsScreen provides UI for Garmin Connect integration following the Strava pattern: GarminConnectionState enum (5 states), GarminSettingsAction enum (5 actions), screen state with user profile/config/pending uploads. Uses GARMIN_BLUE (rgb 0,118,206) brand color. Renders profile with readable_name() from GarminUserProfile, links to connect.garmin.com/modern/profile/{display_name}.

src/app.rs.description: GarminSettingsAction::Connect handler implemented. Uses Arc<DefaultOAuthHandler> initialized with port 8888 for OAuth callback. Garmin credentials loaded from GARMIN_CLIENT_ID and GARMIN_CLIENT_SECRET environment variables. Connect action spawns async task that calls start_authorization(SyncPlatform::GarminConnect), opens browser with auth URL, and stores task handle in pending_garmin_oauth for polling. poll_garmin_oauth() method checks task completion and updates GarminConnectionState. Request repaint enabled when pending_garmin_oauth is Some.
